name: Lingjie Qitan: Wolong
source:
In this surreal afterlife deduction game by CnD Games, play as Zhuge Liang—the East's legendary mastermind. Face off against Sherlock Holmes in the Underworld Olympics and unravel a deadly closed-circle mystery trapped within a snowed-in mountain lodge!

From Steam
translation:
在这款由猫龙游戏（CnD Games）打造的超现实冥界推理游戏中，你将扮演东方的传奇谋略家——诸葛亮。在“冥运会”上与夏洛克·福尔摩斯正面对决，解开被大雪封锁的暴风雪山庄中暗藏杀机的密室谜案！

[摘自Steam]
